```{r global_options}
#| include: false
#| eval: true

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, 
  warning = FALSE, 
  error = FALSE, 
  eval = TRUE)
options(scipen = 999)
## tables may break across pages (tinytable sets non-breakable figures by
## default)
options(tinytable_typst_multipage = TRUE)
cps_report <- readRDS(file = "<CPSR_REPORT_OBJECT.rds>")
no_content <- isFALSE(
  as.logical(cps_report$content$snv_indel$eval))
```

```{r cover_page}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

## secondary findings section included (see below)
sf_enabled <- isTRUE(as.logical(
  cps_report$settings$conf$variant_classification$secondary_findings))

## Cover + key findings - values resolved in R (cpsr:::pdf_cover_typst),
## layout in typst/_preamble.typ (cpsr-cover, cpsr-highlights)
cat(cpsr:::pdf_cover_typst(cps_report))
```
